evidence: Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 declares build_timeout_sec=600.0, network_mode="public", cpus=2 and memory_mb=4096; Python tomllib parsing confirmed its entire environment table equals the frozen template table. No environment secret, docker_image or allow_internet exists. task/environment/Dockerfile:1-26 is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1); its only ENV sets NODE_PATH, with Express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1 preinstalled at lines 9-11. This is sane provisioning for the single Node/SQLite process specified in task/environment/instructions/integration.md:3-10. The COPY inputs were read: seed JSON has synthetic .example accounts and no credentials; hireops_rules.md:25 and :370 contain only the intentional public demo password, also disclosed in instruction.md:15. task.toml:34 is a verifier-side variable template, not an agent secret. Workbook Quality Checks!D10 explicitly requires public networking; Internal Quality Checks!D10 retains historical no-network language, superseded by the current workbook and skill Delivery profile. A conforming app loading a CDN font (instruction.md:9; integration.md:12-14) remains permitted. A broken app that calls an external data backend would violate public product instructions, but no environment credential or blocked-network exemption helps it; row 09 does not establish behavioral grading. Relevant frozen source/rule/template hashes (12 files) and review-policy hash were verified against manifest. Source/configuration review only: no image build, resource measurement, judge run or portal result is claimed.
